distributed platform for running compute in regions around the globe.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">While it is possible to stack an external proxy or load balancer in front of Vercel, this guide outlines some of the downsides and risks to be aware of.</p><h2 class="text-heading-24 font-[450]! @md:text-heading-32 [&:has(_b)]:text-gray-900 [&_b]:text-gray-1000 [&_b]:font-normal group 0 0 0 6.06" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg><span class="sr-only">Copy link to heading</span></a>Using a Proxy in front of Vercel</h2><p class="text-pretty break-words">You might consider placing another proxy in front of Vercel to theoretically allow for multiple layers of protection against malicious actors, or multiple layers of routing rules.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">However, <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">we do not recommend this approach</span>. The biggest disadvantage is that Vercel no longer has full traffic visibility, which prevents the Vercel Firewall and our threat intelligence products from working to their full potential. This includes our ability to automatically challenge requests, prevent DDoS attacks, and more.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">Adding another proxy in front of Vercel will also decrease the performance of your site. Traffic must be routed through two different networks. This means there's additional processing and connection overhead before going back to your origin.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words"><span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">Please proceed with caution</span>. If you decide to deploy your own proxy solution, it is <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">critical</span> that you are aware of the following complications and details.</p><h3 class="text-heading-20 leading-[1.1] font-[450]! @lg:text-heading-32 @lg:text-[28px]! [&:has(_b)]:text-gray-900 [&_b]:text-gray-1000 [&_b]:font-normal group relative w-full text-balance pt-[calc(var(--grid-divider-gap)/1.5)]"><a class="absolute flex h-[1lh] w-8 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-900 opacity-0 transition-all duration-100 -translate-x-full group-hover:opacity-100 hover:text-gray-1000 focus-visible:opacity-100 scroll-mt-10" href="#global-distribution" id="global-distribution"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" height="16" width="16" data-slot="geist-icon" style="color:currentColor"><path fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg><span class="sr-only">Copy link to heading</span></a>Global Distribution</h3><p class="text-pretty break-words">Vercel implements multiple technologies as part of our <a href="https://vercel.com/docs/edge-network/overview" rel="noopener" target="_blank" data-zone="null" class="cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 outline-[var(--ds-focus-color)] outline-offset-4 text-[var(--geist-link-color)] [:not([aria-disabled])]:hover:underline [&_u]:no-underline underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 text-inherit! hover:decoration-1! hover:text-(--geist-link-color)! focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2">Edge Network</a> to guarantee the <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">performance</span> and <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">reachability</span> of all hosted apps. It is important to understand that using your own proxy will affect the performance of your deployments by introducing additional latency, especially if your proxy is not globally available.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">Vercel also ensures that when global Internet infrastructure problems occur, for example, a fiber cable is cut, we can deploy mitigation strategies automatically. An example is traffic re-routing: If a region is experiencing problems, we can redirect traffic to another location without action needed from your team.</p><h3 class="text-heading-20 leading-[1.1] font-[450]! @lg:text-heading-32 @lg:text-[28px]! [&:has(_b)]:text-gray-900 [&_b]:text-gray-1000 [&_b]:font-normal group relative w-full text-balance pt-[calc(var(--grid-divider-gap)/1.5)]"><a class="absolute flex h-[1lh] w-8 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-900 opacity-0 transition-all duration-100 -translate-x-full group-hover:opacity-100 hover:text-gray-1000 focus-visible:opacity-100 scroll-mt-10" href="#reliability" id="reliability"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" height="16" width="16" data-slot="geist-icon" style="color:currentColor"><path fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg><span class="sr-only">Copy link to heading</span></a>Reliability</h3><p class="text-pretty break-words">Using your own proxy can decrease the level of reliability since you are introducing a piece of infrastructure that Vercel does not manage. If a problem happens in your proxy that causes downtime, Vercel cannot deploy any mitigations and intervention by your team may be required.</p><h3 class="text-heading-20 leading-[1.1] font-[450]! @lg:text-heading-32 @lg:text-[28px]! [&:has(_b)]:text-gray-900 [&_b]:text-gray-1000 [&_b]:font-normal group relative w-full text-balance pt-[calc(var(--grid-divider-gap)/1.5)]"><a class="absolute flex h-[1lh] w-8 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-900 opacity-0 transition-all duration-100 -translate-x-full group-hover:opacity-100 hover:text-gray-1000 focus-visible:opacity-100 scroll-mt-10" href="#cache-behavior" id="cache-behavior"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" height="16" width="16" data-slot="geist-icon" style="color:currentColor"><path fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg><span class="sr-only">Copy link to heading</span></a>Cache Behavior</h3><p class="text-pretty break-words">A third party proxy, when used with Vercel, can introduce two caching layers: one at the third party and one at Vercel. This can result in incorrect data being sent to visitors.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">When you push a new deployment to Vercel, our platform will <a href="https://vercel.com/docs/concepts/edge-network/caching#cache-invalidation" rel="noopener" target="_blank" data-zone="null" class="cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 outline-[var(--ds-focus-color)] outline-offset-4 text-[var(--geist-link-color)] [:not([aria-disabled])]:hover:underline [&_u]:no-underline underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 text-inherit! hover:decoration-1! hover:text-(--geist-link-color)! focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2">purge the existing cache</a> across all of our regions automatically. You will need to ensure that your proxy is also respecting this behaviour, and purging its own proxy cache after each deployment.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">You should also ensure the following path is <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">never</span> cached:</p><p class="text-pretty break-words"><code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">https://<YOUR_DOMAIN>/.well-known/vercel/*</code></p><p class="text-pretty break-words">Otherwise, your users may experience stale content, mixed assets, <a href="https://vercel.com/docs/security/attack-challenge-mode" rel="noopener" target="_blank" data-zone="null" class="cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 outline-[var(--ds-focus-color)] outline-offset-4 text-[var(--geist-link-color)] [:not([aria-disabled])]:hover:underline [&_u]:no-underline underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 text-inherit! hover:decoration-1! hover:text-(--geist-link-color)! focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2">challenge mode</a> issues and other unexpected behaviour.</p><h3 class="text-heading-20 leading-[1.1] font-[450]! @lg:text-heading-32 @lg:text-[28px]! Most proxies use a single IP address to connect to our systems, so if we detect an anomaly in requests coming from a single source, the IP can get banned for a period of time ranging from a few minutes to days.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">You must ensure that any traffic mitigation measures, such as DDoS protection, rate limiting or throttling are implemented within your third party proxy, to prevent this traffic from being subsequently routed to Vercel, resulting in your proxy IP address(es) being blocked from accessing Vercel.</p><p class="text-pretty break-words">Additionally, if you run a proxy in front of your Vercel apps, you must ensure that it is sending the SNI hostname correctly.
